name: Industrial Bank Co., Ltd.
summary: Industrial Bank Co., Ltd., established in 1988 and headquartered in Fuzhou, People's Republic of China, operates as a comprehensive financial institution providing a broad spectrum of banking and diversified financial services. Its core banking activities in China encompass accepting deposits from the public, offering various loan types (short, medium, and long-term), and managing both domestic and international settlement operations. The bank is also involved in issuing financial instruments such as discount and financial bonds, processing acceptance bills and notes, and acting as an agent for bond issuance and encashment. It actively participates in capital markets through underwriting and trading government bonds, debentures, financial bonds, and other marketable securities (excluding equities). Additional fundamental services include asset custody, inter-bank lending, and foreign exchange transactions encompassing trading, settlement, and sales. Beyond these traditional offerings, Industrial Bank provides a full suite of customer-centric services. These include bank card services, agency trading, letters of credit and guarantee, remittance facilities, and serving as an insurance agent. Customers can also access safety deposit boxes, receive financial advisory, and utilize credit investigation, advisory, and attestation services. The institution further supports modern banking needs with extensive digital platforms, including debit and credit cards, internet banking, and mobile banking services. Through its network of subsidiaries, Industrial Bank extends its reach into diverse specialized financial sectors. This includes finance leasing, trust services, fund raising and marketing, comprehensive asset management, and consumer finance. The group also engages in strategic equity and industrial investments, alongside providing expert investment management, advisory, and consulting services. Further specialized areas cover financial, business, and enterprise management consulting; sophisticated financial data processing; brokerage services for commodity and financial futures; futures investment consulting; and economic information consulting. The company even contributes to technological infrastructure through application software development and system integration. Moreover, the bank is actively involved in broader financial health management, including the acquisition, transfer, and disposal of non-performing loans (bad debts) from both financial and non-financial entities. It also develops and distributes a variety of wealth management products and offers related consulting and advisory services.
